query: AMD Data Center revenue FY2026 full year
normalized: amd center data full fy2026 revenue year

output.content:
AMD has **not reported FY2026 full-year Data Center revenue** as of October 17, 2026; it is scheduled to report Q3 FY2026 results on November 3, 2026, so the fiscal year is still incomplete. [[1]] 

The latest reported cumulative figure is **$12.493 billion for the first half of FY2026**, comprising **$5.775 billion in Q1** and **$6.718 billion in Q2**. [[2]]
